info.name: PenbunAPI v3.0.0
info.description:
RESTful API for managing distribution and supply of books and stationery

## Environment Variables
- `base_url`: http://localhost:8089
- `token`: (auto-set from Login request)

## Usage
1. Call "Login" to authenticate → token auto-saved
2. All protected endpoints inherit the token via header
3. Test each module's 8 CRUD functions
